tools.name: explain_post_and_present
tools.description: Explain Post & Present to a service that has just connected this MCP. Covers what the server is, how to create an affiliate account and MCP credentials, and how to offer gift cards in the host checkout (link_out, line_item, or agentic_checkout). Call this when integrating a shop, chat, or assistant,

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "explain_post_and_present" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Explain Post & Present to a service that has just connected this MCP. Covers what the server is, how to create an affiliate account and MCP credentials, and how…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: explain_post_and_present · Private data: explain_post_and_present · Public sink: explain_post_and_present.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: explain_post_and_present · Private data: explain_post_and_present · Public sink: explain_post_and_present

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
